title: Arcane Shot: Grasping Arrow
html:
Arcane Shot: Grasping Arrow is a special arcane arrow attack available to Arcane Archers which deals an extra 2d6⁠⁠Poison damage and hinders the target's movement.

Description

Deal an additional 2d6⁠⁠Poison damage. Affected entity's movement speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft) and it will take 2d6⁠⁠Slashing damage when it moves.

Bugs

  • Due to an incorrectly used DamageBonus function, the bonus damage that Arcane Shots deliver on striking an enemy is not doubled on a critical hit.
